The climate in Heraklion

Heraklion is about 17 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 9°C. Around 450 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 70 mm). The highest temperature in Heraklion in 2015–2024 was 45°C (14 June 2024) and the lowest 0°C (9 January 2017).

Best time to visit Heraklion

The most pleasant weather in Heraklion is usually in April, May and October: average highs are between 22°C and 25°C, with up to 6 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
